prediction.raw: 0 I think it's wrong to expect your friends to agree with you just because you've stated your opinion. Friends can have varying viewpoints, and it's healthy to engage in discussions, debates, and even disagreements. Expecting automatic agreement can stifle open communication, creativity, and growth in relationships. Instead, it's more valuable to foster an environment where everyone feels comfortable sharing their thoughts and listening to each other's perspectives.
